name: PersonalRAGVault
description: Search local documents and notes with hybrid retrieval and source previews through a Python CLI or local HTTP API; optionally compose answers with Ollama.

skills.name: Ingest Local Files
skills.description: Index selected local documents and notes with stable chunk IDs; preview ingestion through a dry run before adding personal files.

skills.name: Retrieve Source Text
skills.description: Combine semantic and keyword retrieval and inspect matching source text without requiring a generation provider.

skills.name: Optional Local Answers
skills.description: Compose answers from retrieved context with a configured Ollama model; review citations and use retrieval-only mode when preferred.
